description: The files that may write to the process's own console or streams instead of the one logger (core/kit/log.js), each with why. core/test/logging-guard.test.js fails when any other file under core/, server/src or desktop/src logs or writes to a stream outside the logger, so this list is the single, reviewable way to add one.

allow.reason: the sink itself writes each approved line to the process's stdout or stderr
the CLI entry reports an uncaught startup error on stderr before the logger exists
the command line prints its answer to the person's terminal, which is not a log line
the same file is the smoke proof driver, and prints each check on stdout when it runs as one
the design capture prints its result on stdout
the real-input region probe prints its report on stdout
